Commodore bus.fact: When all bus listeners are ready to receive they release the Data line to false. If the Data line being false (released) isn't acknowledged by the talker within 200 μs, the listener knows that the talker is in the process of EOI that means "this character will be the last one".

Commodore bus.question: The talker can revert to transmitting again within 60 μs by pulling the _____ line true

Commodore bus.question: Once the _____ line is set, the Clock line is released to false
